id: title:Gilbert09:explain oauth failures caused by rejected app credentials

review.posthog_relevance: Adds OAuth error handling and credential rejection detection for Meta/Instagram account connections, improving diagnostics and preventing credential reuse after rejection.
review.reason: Adds nested error message extraction and credential rejection detection for Meta's Graph API, including a ValidationError with a clear message. This improves OAuth diagnostics and credential rejection handling for users connecting Instagram accounts. The chunk does not establish whether the OAuth integration is fully implemented or production-enabled, so the tier is conservative.
review.uncertainty: Chunk does not establish complete implementation or production configuration; score assigned based on observable code changes rather than established benefit.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the OAuth integration or the relevant production configuration, so it cannot establish whether the Instagram/Meta support is actually enabled or used. The score cannot be assigned without this context.

observations.behavior: Adds nested error message extraction for Meta's Graph API, which nests the error in an object whose trace id and codes mean nothing to the customer.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to extract the human-readable OAuth error message from Meta's nested response structure, improving error diagnostics for users connecting Instagram accounts.

observations.behavior: Adds a constant message and a helper function to detect when an OAuth provider rejected PostHog's own client credentials.
observations.posthog_connection: Detects credential rejection to distinguish between transient errors and account-specific credential issues, potentially preventing repeated failed connection attempts.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper function to detect client credentials rejection and a corresponding error message, and raises a ValidationError with that message.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a clear, actionable error message to users when their OAuth credentials are rejected, rather than a generic OAuth failure, and routes them to support.
